prompt:
Scene:
A top-down square photograph of a DIY map zine page on slightly tanned manila paper, morning room light from upper right, worn edges from being folded twice.

Subject:
A hand-drawn DIY map page: a torn photocopied city street grid pasted over the center, over-drawn with thick red marker routes, labeled with small ballpoint handwriting arrows, and dotted with pasted paper circles each marking a location. Three small torn polaroid-style photographs are tucked along the right margin with short crayon annotations. Dashed marker lines trace walking paths.

Important details:
The map paper must have fold creases with real shadow. Red marker routes must show the pen's wet edge wobble. Small ballpoint arrows feel hand-lettered — uneven stroke pressure. Crayon annotations have waxy texture. Torn polaroid corners are ragged.

Use case:
Independent single image in the Collage Moods package, representing the DIY wayfinder voice.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no real city names, no vector cartography, no HDR, no symmetry, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.

description: A DIY zine map page with pasted photocopied street grid, red marker routes, ballpoint arrows, and tucked polaroid fragments.
